name: Reaction-shot cutting at the emotional peak

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-5, 2026-11-27): a wordless portrait 3D character story keeps its setup and ending as long takes and cuts fast between the hero and the others only at the emotional middle.

technique: In a wordless character story the setup and the resolution are long takes and the emotional middle is cut fast between the character's close-up and the others' reactions (shot-reverse-shot). The cutting speed shows the feeling rising; the long final take lets it settle.
purpose: Let the edit rate carry the feeling: long takes for setup and resolution, fast shot-reverse-shot where the emotion peaks.
visual_behaviour: Two long establishing shots; then five quick shots alternate between the hero's close-up and the others' reactions, each cut on a look or a hop; then one long take rises over the result and holds into the end card. Fades only at the very start and end.
mechanics: Two long setup shots (8.4 and 10.4 s), then five shots of 0.7-2.6 s (median 2.0 s), each cut on a look or a hop, then one 14.2 s take that rises over the result and holds into the end card. No transition effects; fades from and to black only at the ends.

decomposition.timing: Middle act 8.6 s in 5 shots; outer shots 8.4-14.2 s.

use_cases: Story beats in explainers with a mascot
Any wordless story with a turn
failure_modes: Fast cutting everywhere removes the peak
Cutting away during an action instead of on a look loses the thread

implementation.approach: Group the middle act into 4-6 hard cuts (Studio.cut) of 0.7-2.6 s, median about 2 s, each on a look or a small action; keep the setup shots 8-10 s and the resolution one 10-14 s take. The characters themselves are rendered 3D: plates from the visual-director, with the cuts made in HyperFrames.

requirements: shots that can be cut on a look

provenance.observed: Shots of 8.4 and 10.4 s, then cuts at 18.97, 21.00, 22.27, 23.00 and 25.60 s between the left-out tile's close-ups and the others, then one 14.2 s take from 27.57 s to the end.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
